# 📊 Summaries & Keywords with Gemini

Condense long texts and pull out keywords — one document at a time, or hundreds of rows
in a spreadsheet.

**Run the steps in order, from top to bottom.** Each one has a ▶️ button on its left.

> ⚠️ **Before uploading research material, read Step 1's privacy notice.** These
> institutional notebooks require a billing-enabled project and any ethics/DPO approval
> applicable to the material. Regional Gemini API terms differ.

## Step 1: Prepare the notebook ⚙️

Click the ▶ button beside the code below. If Google asks whether to run this notebook,
check that you opened the ZMO repository, then continue. Wait for **Setup complete**
before moving on. You do not need to change the code or select a GPU.

Run each numbered cell in order. Some cells display a form: fill it in and click its
button before continuing. If you see a red error, stop at that step and read the message.
After a disconnected session, start again from Step 1.

## Step 2: Connect your Gemini API key 🔑

An API key lets this notebook use your Google AI project. Create one at
[Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Creating a key and paying for
processing are separate: use the billing-enabled project required by Step 1.

Run the cell below and follow **Colab Secrets** instructions. Enable **Notebook access**
for each notebook separately. Never paste a key into the code or share it with anyone.

# ============================================
# STEP 2 — API KEY (Colab Secrets first)
# ============================================
key_panel = zc.ApiKeyPanel()
key_panel.display()
display(HTML(zc.api_key_migration_notice()))

## Step 2.5: Connect Google Drive (strongly recommended) ☁️

Drive stores an atomic workbook checkpoint plus a matching manifest. A new Colab runtime can
restore it after you reconnect Drive, select the same source workbook, and choose the same
model, prompt, worksheet, column, and header row.

# ============================================ # STEP 2.5 — GOOGLE DRIVE # ============================================ drive_status = widgets.HTML() drive_save_enabled = widgets.Checkbox( value=True, description='Save results to Google Drive as the run progresses', style={'description_width': 'initial'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='460px'), disabled=True, ) drive_folder_input = widgets.Text( value=drive.folder_name, description='Folder:', style={'description_width': '80px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='400px'), disabled=True, ) def connect_drive(_button): drive_status.value = "🔄 Connecting…" if drive.mount(): drive_save_enabled.disabled = False drive_folder_input.disabled = False # Step 3 may not have been run yet, in which case there is no file # picker to refresh -- and that is fine, it will build itself connected. if 'file_selector' in globals(): file_selector.build_drive_tab() drive_status.value = ( "

You can still upload " "and download files manually." ) def on_folder_change(change): try: drive.folder_name = change['new'].strip() or 'Colab_Summaries' except ValueError: drive_status.value = ( "❌ Use a folder inside My Drive; " "absolute paths and .. are not allowed." ) drive_folder_input.observe(on_folder_change, names='value') connect_button = widgets.Button( description='☁️ Connect Google Drive', button_style='primary', layout=widgets.Layout(width='230px', height='40px'), ) connect_button.on_click(connect_drive) display(connect_button) display(drive_status) display(HTML("
Saving options (available once connected):")) display(drive_save_enabled) display(drive_folder_input)

## Step 3: Choose your texts 📁

- **Text files** (`.txt`, `.md`) — each one gets its own summary
- **Spreadsheets** (`.xlsx`) — a *Summary* and a *Keywords* column are added next to your text

Text files produced by the OCR notebook work here directly.

# ============================================
# STEP 3 — CHOOSE FILES
# ============================================
file_selector = zc.FileSelector(
    dest_dir=FOLDERS['input'],
    extensions=ALL_EXTENSIONS,
    drive=drive,
    icon_for=document_icon,
    what='texts',
    size_hint_mb=100,
)
file_selector.display()

## Step 4: Settings 🎛️

Choose the worksheet and text column explicitly. The output remains an `.xlsx` workbook:
all worksheets and existing cells/styles/formulas are retained, and three columns are added
to the selected sheet: **AI Summary**, **AI Keywords**, and **AI Status**.

For very large, non-urgent sheets, Batch mode costs 50% of synchronous requests and normally
finishes sooner than its 24-hour target. Submission and collection are separate operations.

# ============================================ # STEP 4 — SETTINGS # ============================================ model_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown( options=zc.MODEL_CHOICES, value=zc.MODEL_FLASH, description='Model:', style={'description_width': '120px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='560px'), ) model_info = widgets.HTML() def update_model_info(change): model = change['new'] if 'pro' in model: model_info.value = ( "

" ) elif 'lite' in model: model_info.value = ( "
" "🪶 Fastest and cheapest. Validate a representative sample against " "Flash before processing a large corpus.
" ) else: model_info.value = ( "
" "⚡ Fixed Flash release — the default for summaries. Balanced quality, " "speed and cost for most rows.
" ) model_dropdown.observe(update_model_info, names='value') update_model_info({'new': model_dropdown.value}) sheet_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown( options=[], description='Worksheet:', style={'description_width': '120px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='460px'), ) column_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown( options=[], description='Text column:', style={'description_width': '120px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='460px'), ) header_row_input = widgets.BoundedIntText( value=1, min=1, max=1000, description='Header row:', style={'description_width': '120px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='260px'), ) column_status = widgets.HTML( "Press Inspect workbook after choosing an .xlsx file in Step 3." ) def selected_sheet_file(): sheets = [ Path(path) for path in file_selector.selected if Path(path).suffix.lower() in SHEET_EXTENSIONS ] return sheets[0] if sheets else None def read_headers(path, sheet_name, header_row): workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False) try: worksheet = workbook[sheet_name] headers = [] for cell in worksheet[header_row]: if cell.value is not None and str(cell.value).strip(): headers.append(str(cell.value)) return headers finally: workbook.close() def refresh_columns(_change=None): path = selected_sheet_file() if not path or not sheet_dropdown.value: return try: columns = read_headers(path, sheet_dropdown.value, header_row_input.value) except Exception as exc: column_status.value = ( f"❌ Could not read headers: {escape(str(exc))}" ) return if not columns: column_status.value = "❌ No headers found on that row." column_dropdown.options = [] return column_dropdown.options = columns column_dropdown.value = 'OCR' if 'OCR' in columns else columns[0] column_status.value = ( f"✅ {len(columns)} column(s) on " f"{escape(sheet_dropdown.value)}. Original sheets and formatting are preserved." ) def inspect_workbook(_button): path = selected_sheet_file() if not path: column_status.value = ( "⚠️ Select an .xlsx file in Step 3 first." ) return try: workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False) names = list(workbook.sheetnames) workbook.close() except Exception as exc: column_status.value = ( f"❌ Could not inspect it: {escape(str(exc))}" ) return sheet_dropdown.options = names sheet_dropdown.value = names[0] if names else None refresh_columns() sheet_dropdown.observe(refresh_columns, names='value') header_row_input.observe(refresh_columns, names='value') columns_button = widgets.Button( description='🔎 Inspect workbook', button_style='info', layout=widgets.Layout(width='200px'), ) columns_button.on_click(inspect_workbook) use_custom_prompt = widgets.Checkbox( value=False, description='Add my own summary instructions', style={'description_width': 'initial'}, ) custom_prompt_text = widgets.Textarea( placeholder=( 'For example: Focus on the religious institutions mentioned. ' 'Do not paste source text here.' ), layout=widgets.Layout(width='560px', height='120px'), disabled=True, ) def toggle_custom(change): custom_prompt_text.disabled = not change['new'] use_custom_prompt.observe(toggle_custom, names='value') save_every_slider = widgets.IntSlider( value=50, min=1, max=500, step=1, description='Export every:', style={'description_width': '140px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='440px'), ) batch_checkbox = widgets.Checkbox( value=False, description='Submit spreadsheet rows with the Batch API (50% cost; asynchronous)', style={'description_width': 'initial'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='650px'), ) restart_checkbox = widgets.Checkbox( value=False, description='Start a separate run (keep previous results)', style={'description_width': 'initial'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='560px'), ) display(HTML("

Submit in Step 5, then use Collect batch " "results later—even in a new runtime after reconnecting Drive and selecting the same source." )) display(restart_checkbox) column_policy = widgets.Dropdown(options=[("Create separate columns", "new"), ("Replace existing AI columns", "replace"), ("Stop on collision", "error")], description="AI columns:", style={"description_width": "initial"}) display(column_policy)

## Step 5: Preview and run / resume

Preview scope before sending data. Resume with the same source and settings to reuse completed rows, pages, or segments. Changed settings start a separate run. Batch jobs must be collected or cancelled before switching that run to synchronous processing.

## Step 6: Download, recover, and review

Download a recovery ZIP, including partial output, provenance, and resume state. Import it after a runtime reset. Re-select the original source to resume. The review panel keeps corrections separate from the original model output.

## Optional: temporary files

Temporary audio segments and upload buffers are cleaned automatically. Keep run folders and recovery ZIPs while work is active. Colab removes local files when the runtime ends.
print("Keep your recovery ZIPs and Drive run folders until you have verified your results.")

## Help

- A run is identified by source bytes, model, prompts, and settings. Matching runs resume automatically.
- Each completed unit is saved locally. Drive synchronization happens at export checkpoints; download the recovery ZIP if a mirror fails.
- A partial, failed, or truncated unit remains eligible for retry. Keep the raw output for comparison.
- Excel formulas need cached values: recalculate and save the source in Excel or LibreOffice when preflight flags a missing cache. Generated cells are always literal text.
- PDF text-layer extraction is an explicit option. Inspect the samples first; the existing layer may itself contain OCR errors.
- Request and price estimates exclude retries, thinking, and provider-specific media tokenization. They are planning estimates, not billing caps.
- For CLI, recovery details, and evaluation, see [the project documentation](https://github.com/fmadore/zmo-ai-pipelines).
